title: Occam's Razor is Only as Sharp as Your ELBO
abstract: arXiv:2604.25984v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The marginal likelihood, also known as the evidence, is regarded as a mathematical embodiment of Occam's razor, enabling hyperparameter selection that avoids overfitting. The evidence lower bound (ELBO) objective from variational inference has also been used for similar purposes. In this paper, we define a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for Bayesian linear regression in terms of key hyperparameters controlling signal and noise variance. We then study how ELBO-based hyperparameter learning can under or overestimate SNR depending on the assumed covariance matrix structure in a Gaussian approximate posterior. We prove that assuming a diagonal or low-rank plus diagonal covariance matrix underestimates the SNR, while a low-rank covariance matrix overestimates the SNR. Underestimating the SNR leads to higher than optimal mean squared error on the training set (underfitting), while overestimating SNR leads to lower error (overfitting). B

translated_title: 奥卡姆剃刀的锋利程度取决于你的ELBO
translated_abstract: 边际似然，也被称为证据，被视为奥卡姆剃刀的数学体现，使超参数选择能够避免过拟合。来自变分推断的证据下界目标函数也被用于类似的目的。在本文中，我们针对贝叶斯线性回归定义了一个信噪比，该信噪比由控制信号方差和噪声方差的关键超参数表示。随后，我们研究了基于ELBO的超参数学习如何根据高斯近似后验中所假设的协方差矩阵结构而低估或高估信噪比。我们证明了假设对角协方差矩阵或低秩加对角协方差矩阵会低估信噪比，而低秩协方差矩阵会高估信噪比。低估信噪比会导致训练集上的均方误差高于最优值（欠拟合），而高估信噪比则会导致误差更低（过拟合）。
tldr: 本文证明在贝叶斯线性回归中，基于ELBO的超参数学习会因高斯近似后验协方差结构的不同而产生系统性偏差：对角或低秩加对角协方差会低估信噪比导致欠拟合，而低秩协方差会高估信噪比导致过拟合。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in Bayesian linear regression, ELBO-based hyperparameter learning systematically biases the signal-to-noise ratio depending on the approximate posterior covariance structure: diagonal or low-rank plus diagonal covariance underestimates SNR and causes underfitting, while low-rank covariance overestimates SNR and causes overfitting.
